== Published English Original Virtual Set 4 wording ==
The original requires a hit by the opponent’s character weapon. The later printed trigger says just hit by a character weapon and adds a hyphen to the title. Droid loss, the shooter target and the destiny/defense/forfeit effects remain. The source does not establish a specific legal friendly-fire example.
